evidence: All three fixed seeds (42, 17, 73) completed 240 epochs. Evaluation uses the same 5,000 validation images, FP32 and an uncalibrated equal average of original and horizontally flipped image probabilities; the official test set was not evaluated.
failed_guards: Mean clean-accuracy change -0.153333 pp is below the -0.10 pp margin.
Only 1 of 3 seeds has a clean-accuracy change >= -0.10 pp; at least 2 are required.
meaningful_benefits: All three seeds improve accuracy under the fixed noise condition; mean NLL and ECE improve on both clean and noisy images. The clean top-1 accuracy guard fails.
uncertainty: The conditional image interval for the clean-accuracy change includes zero. It does not establish significant harm, independent confirmation, generalization to unseen corruptions, or an isolated CE-versus-BN effect; retraining uncertainty is not included.

cost.scope: Original wall-clock durations include pauses, the teacher and input augmentation; they are not pure GPU timings or equal-FLOP comparisons.
